title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
abstract: arXiv:2610.35817v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube

translated_title: 预训练懂得“做什么”，仿真教会“怎么做”：仿真训练的机器人智能体的组合泛化
translated_abstract: 机器人策略需要理解场景中任务所要求的是什么，以及如何移动机器人来完成该任务。为了实现这两项技能，我们提出了零真实智能体策略，这是一种通过简单的工具框架来教会小型现成视觉语言模型控制机器人的方法。我们使用一个预训练的270亿参数模型来构建世界理解与推理能力，随后在简单的仿真任务上进行监督微调和GRPO，以教会它如何移动机器人。在训练过程中不使用任何真实世界机器人数据的情况下，ZAP在真实世界任务上达到了96.7%的成功率，在我们的框架中与GPT-6 Astra相当，并优于MolmoAct2 VLA（33.3%），同时运行速度比GPT-6 Astra快3倍、成本低17倍。我们证明ZAP还能泛化到全新的物体、目标、策略和语言，例如将试管放入试管架（并在被提示时选择架子上的不同孔位）、递送试管……
tldr: 提出零真实机器人策略ZAP，仅借助预训练视觉语言模型加上简单仿真任务上的监督微调与GRPO训练，无需任何真实机器人数据，即可在真实世界任务上达到96.7%成功率，并对新物体、目标、策略和语言展现出组合泛化能力。
en_tdlr: ZAP trains a small off-the-shelf vision-language model entirely on simple simulated tasks (SFT + GRPO), achieving 96.7% success on real-world robot tasks without any real robot data, demonstrating compositional generalization to novel objects, goals, strategies, and language.
